## Rating

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple" title="Met"}
A log of all commands used to set up the environment (installation, configuration) and to run the analysis is included (e.g. a setup script, shell history, or run logs).
:::
::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple" title="Partially met"}
A log exists but covers only part of the process (e.g. analysis run logs but not the setup, or the setup but not the run).
:::
::: {.callout-important appearance="simple" title="Not met"}
No command log is provided.
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Not applicable"}
